headline: Vietnam: facilitating the registration and negotiation of corporate bonds placed privately
summary: The article discusses how Vietnamese companies can raise funds through privately placed corporate bonds with fewer procedural obstacles. It also addresses investor protection.
why: Corporate bond markets provide funding alternatives to bank loans and affect the cost of capital for listed and unlisted companies.
